text:
tess_sales: Starting thread for Argenta Bank POC. Need final scope: SAML flow, SCIM provisioning auth, group->role mapping, domain proof method, and a committed Dedicated estimate for finance.

ron_se: Quick asks: IdP metadata (XML or URL), SP vs IdP-initiated, NameID format (email preferred?), SCIM auth choice (bearer vs mTLS), and exact domains to validate.

client_it_argenta: We'll send metadata URL today. SP-initiated preferred, NameID=email. SCIM bearer token OK for POC; we will discuss mTLS for prod. Domains: argenta.com and eu.argenta.com.

hema_ts: For RBAC are you planning groups->roles or claims->roles? Group mapping is faster for POC. Also confirm externalId format.

client_it_argenta: Group->role mapping. externalId = "arg|<id>". We'll include group list in the payload.

dwight_security: Security summary: 1) POC token OK, prod should use mTLS. 2) Audit logs default 90d; enterprise upgrade to 365d available (cost uplift). 3) SAML cert rotation supported (manual + metadata refresh if IdP exposes). 4) Domain verification via DNS TXT per domain; org-level delegation needs proof for each delegated owner and will add ~2-4 business days per external domain. Also require completed security questionnaire before Dedicated commit.

maria_legal: Legal needs a short SOW clause for SSO/SCIM (cert rotation, metadata exchange, provisioning termination, data residency). I can paste a 3-line snippet once scope is confirmed.

ron_se: SCIM smoke payload we'll use for testing (example):
```json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:ListResponse"],
  "Resources": [
    {
      "id": "u-700",
      "userName": "k.lee@argenta.com",
      "externalId": "arg|700",
      "emails": [{"value": "k.lee@argenta.com"}],
      "groups": ["payments","ops"]
    }
  ]
}
```
We'll map payments->payments-analyst, ops->ops-operator. Set SCIM initial rate-limit to 50 req/min.

tess_sales: Pricing ask: committed Dedicated for ~130 req/s sustained, ~1.25M tokens/day. Need monthly reserved + overage, 24/7 enterprise support, EU data residency. Ron, can you prepare a customer-facing estimate and call out caveats for per-route RBAC and quantized-model performance?

ron_se: Will draft estimate: reserved GPU pool monthly + overage per 1k tokens, 24/7 support line item, extended logging option, and a note about higher commit for strict latency SLOs. Also include onboarding delta for multi-domain DNS validation.

client_it_argenta: Legal requires SOW clause + estimate within 24h to release budget. Can you confirm EU region availability?

dwight_security: EU region available. I'll prepare the security QA and the short SOW clause. Note: if Argenta opts for per-route logging, tenant-scoped keys, or mTLS, onboarding time and cost will increase.

hema_ts: Implementation plan for POC: 1) ingest IdP metadata and configure SP-initiated SAML on staging; 2) configure SCIM with groups->roles mapping and run a smoke sync; 3) validate DNS TXT on both domains; 4) run load test with KV/prefix cache enabled to measure latency; 5) hand off sizing for Dedicated if tests pass.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled: feature/argenta-identity-poc -> staging at 2024-10-20T22:00Z :rocket:

tess_sales: Action items: client to send metadata + SCIM token + group list today; Ron to send estimate; Maria_legal to post SOW snippet; Dwight to fill security QA. Sync in 24h. :thumbsup:
